from pathlib import Path

input_path = Path("/mnt/data/spreadsheet/38332/1_38332_input.xlsx")

    if value is not None and value != "":
        unique_values_in_a.add(value)

        ws.cell(row=row, column=4).value = 1 if lookup_value in unique_values_in_a else 0
